series_level_findings: MALAYSIA: The organiser hub is IIUM's Kulliyyah of ICT site https://www.iium.edu.my/acmicpc/ (per-year folders: alkhawarizmi11/ incl. result2011.html, 2011/Report-Closure-ACM-ICPC-Regional-KL.pdf, 2016/, 2018/, 2019/ incl. 2019/scoreboard.html and 2019/regional/). IIUM says it has promoted ICPC since 2007. Hosts rotate: 2009 ? (UTP 1st runner-up, 22-23 Nov 2009), 2011 IIUM, 2012 UiTM Shah Alam (3-4 Nov, 48 teams/19 univs, UTP won), 2013 unknown, 2014 UTP Seri Iskandar (27-28 Sept), 2016 IIUM (7-8 Oct), 2018 IIUM (11-12 May), 2019 IIUM (26-27 Apr). UTAR 'KitKat' (coach Dr Ng Yen Kaow) won 2014, 2016, 2018; IIUM won 2019. Best press vein: fsi.com.my (Chinese-language education press) and university news (UTAR, UTP, IIUM, XMUM). Many IIUM sub-pages are search-indexed but dead to the fetcher (client error) - a browser/Wayback pass over iium.edu.my/acmicpc/* would likely recover 2016/2018/2019 scoreboards. PHILIPPINES: structure in the 2010s was multi-site qualifiers (Metro Manila by CompSAt/Ateneo, Northern Luzon at CSU/USL Tuguegarao, Southern Luzon at Ateneo de Naga) feeding a national final; Contest Director Dr. Rafael P. Saldaña (Ateneo), judge Jaderick Pabico (UPLB). 2014 national: 6 Sept 2014, Ateneo de Naga, Ateneo won. 2015 national final was announced for 19 Oct 2015 at University of Saint Louis Tuguegarao (catalogue's 5 Sept 2015 date may be the Metro Manila qualifier). 2017 national existed (LinkedIn). Nothing found for the Jan-2020 edition; CSP/ICPC-Philippines Facebook is the likely only record. THAILAND: the 2024 revival at Chulalongkorn ran 7-8 Sept 2024 (contest 8 Sept), 57 registered teams, CF gym 105335, site icpc-2024.cp.eng.chula.ac.th - the catalogue's 2024-11-16 date is wrong. The 2025 edition is at KMITL 6-7 Sept 2025. TAIWAN/FAR EAST: WF 1994 (Phoenix, 9 Mar 1994) Far East qualifiers = NTHU (27th) and CUHK (32nd), confirming the 1993 Far East regional produced two qualifiers. Prof. Chang-Biau Yang (NSYSU) slides give Taiwanese milestones: 1991 NCTU first Asian WF team; 1995 Taiwan first hosted an 'Asia regional' - so the Nov-1993 NTHU event may have been regarded as a Far East 'site' rather than Taiwan hosting; worth asking Prof. Yang or NTHU CS (Cheng-Ming Weng) directly. EdUHK's library clipping repository (libdr2.eduhk.hk) holds 1990s HK press on ACM contests (found a 1999 item) - a promising vein for 1993-95 HK coverage. HKU Prof. Kao's SPC site (i.cs.hku.hk/~kao/spc/) has 1994/1995 contest PostScript docs. ICPC's own history/results pages (icpc.global/community/results-1994, history-icpc-1994/1995) are JS shells to the fetcher.
